Description

This sleeveless maxi dress features a vibrant multicolor rustic flower print in warm terracotta, black, and cream tones across a flowing silhouette. The square neckline frames the chest elegantly, while strategic ruching through the bodice and skirt creates flattering dimension and movement. The dress flows to a graceful maxi length with a softly gathered hem, making it an effortless choice for warm-weather occasions.

  • Neckline: Square Neckline
  • Sleeve type: Sleeveless
